## A11Y Issues Found + Fixed

**Category A — Interactive Element Accessible Names: 8 fixed**
- FAQ accordion: added `aria-controls`, `role="region"` on panel, changed `<nav>` panel to `<div>`, changed `<h6>` to `<h3>`, added `aria-labelledby`

- All decorative icon images: changed `alt="[icon name]"` to `alt="" aria-hidden="true"` across pricing, footer, newsletter, beta-cta, faq
- FAQ "Send us a message" link: changed from `href="#"` dead link to `/contact`
- Typewriter: added `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` for screen reader announcements

**Category B — Heading hierarchy: 1 fixed**
- FAQ accordion: changed `<h6>` (skipping h2→h3→h4→h5→h6) to `<h3>`

**Category C — Modals (role + focus trap): 2 fixed**
- `BetaPopupTrigger` in beta-cta.tsx: added `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`, Escape key handler, full focus trap, body scroll lock
- `PortfolioPopup`: added full focus trap, `aria-labelledby` linked to visible title, `aria-label` only as fallback for iframe mode

**Category D — Keyboard navigation: 5 fixed**
- Navbar logo: removed incorrect `aria-current="page"` (only valid on the current page link, not a logo)
- Nav `<nav>` element: added `aria-label="Main navigation"`, removed redundant `role="navigation"`
- Footer: added `aria-label="Site footer"` to `<footer>` element
- MobileNavGroup: added `aria-controls` + `id` on submenu panel
- ScopeTabs platform + tier tabs: added `aria-controls`, `id`, `tabIndex` (roving), `role="tabpanel"` with `aria-labelledby`
- CareersTabs: added `aria-controls`, `id`, `tabIndex` (roving) on all 4 tabs
- JobAccordion: added `aria-controls`, `id`, `role="region"`, `aria-labelledby` on panel

**Category E — Reduced motion: 4 fixed**
- `FadeIn`: wrapped with `useReducedMotion()` — returns plain `<div>` when reduced motion requested
- `ScrollReveal`: same pattern
- `Typewriter`: stops cycling phrases when reduced motion; wraps output in static span
- `FeaturedLogos`: moved animation from inline style to CSS class `.logo-3-scroll-track`; `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` now correctly targets it; logo section marked `aria-hidden="true"` (decorative)
- `globals.css`: added `* { animation-duration: 0.01ms; transition-duration: 0.01ms }` catch-all for CSS animations

**Category F — Screen reader landmarks: 3 fixed**
- `<main id="main-content">` added in layout.tsx so skip-to-content link works
- Removed duplicate `id="main-content"` from Hero div
- `aria-label="Newsletter subscription"` + `aria-label="Contact form"` on forms
